name: Prohibition of discriminatory proxies in selection
description: A job offer must not filter candidates by protected attributes such as age, gender, or nationality. These fields constitute prohibited discriminatory proxies under EU Directive 2000/78/EC and Italian Codice Pari Opportunità (D.Lgs. 198/2006).
requiredActions: Hide the offer from automated recommendations.
Notify the offer's owner to remove the discriminatory field.
